name: Aircall
description: Aircall is a cloud business-phone and customer-communications platform for teams operating voice and messaging workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Aircall company through Relay-owned administrator OAuth, then let agents read bounded company aggregates and the first ten privacy-masked numbers without installer identity, users, communications, recordings, routing, writes, pagination, exports, or raw APIs.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRCALL_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Aircall OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held client ID for a reviewed Aircall technology-partner OAuth app.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRCALL_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Aircall OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-encrypted confidential OAuth secret; never sent to Relay clients or agents.

capabilities.label: Read connected company
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded aggregate details for the exact OAuth-bound Aircall company.

capabilities.label: List company numbers
capabilities.description: Inspect at most ten privacy-masked company phone numbers without users, routing, recordings, messages, or direct links.

allowed.label: Read connected company
allowed.description: Read bounded aggregate company details without provider IDs or installer identity.

allowed.label: List company numbers
allowed.description: Read the first ten privacy-masked numbers without sensitive adjacent fields.

blocked.label: Block users, installers, and administration
blocked.description: Users, installer identity, email, provider IDs, teams, roles, settings, and administration are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block communications and sensitive artifacts
blocked.description: Calls, messages, recordings, voicemail, transcripts, contacts, routing, audio URLs, and communication intelligence are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block writes, exports, and raw access
blocked.description: Dialing, messaging, AI voice, analytics exports, webhooks, pagination, arbitrary paths, writes, deletes, and raw APIs are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Two fixed company reads run automatically; sensitive adjacent data and all writes remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two reads run without Relay per-action approval; company binding, masking, request bounds, audits, and secret isolation remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Aircall reads while Railway alone holds the confidential OAuth client, non-expiring token, and company binding.

providerSetup.blocker: Aircall technology-partner OAuth credentials, exact Railway callback, API-license/privacy/brand review, provider Marketplace acceptance, representative administrator consent, and staging validation remain for separate authorized tasks.
providerSetup.nextAction: After batch integration, register the exact callback and staging credentials, then validate state, JSON code exchange, exact public_api grant, private company binding and drift denial, both bounded reads, masking, 512 KiB limits, 429 behavior without retry, upstream integration disable, local deletion, and post-disconnect denial.
